olivia_sales: Heads-up 1: new POC with MarketLane. Requirements: streaming + function/tool calling for enrichment, and strict structured order JSON per their schema. Must go through an on-prem proxy and they want ephemeral creds + field-level encryption for customer PII. Any quick presales runbook we can hand them?
priya_se: Quick clarifying Q: expected qps and token lengths? that drives batching windows and cache strategy.
olivia_sales: Steady ~20 qps, short peaks to ~140 qps (10-30s), avg seq ~280 tokens. They have many repeated prefixes (order headers).
alyssa_prod: Suggested approach: private or dedicated pilot. Use KV prefix cache to cut token costs for repeated headers. For streaming+toolcalls use `response_mode=streaming` + `tools` schema. Tools stream as events: `tool_start`, `tool_output`, `tool_end`. Client must merge these with token stream to assemble final JSON.
diego_sre: On-prem proxy notes: ensure sticky NAT or pass X-Forwarded-For so JWTs bound to IP stay valid. If proxy modifies body (e.g., encryption), we need TLS passthrough. Also watch connection timeouts on long-lived streams.
priya_se: For ephemeral creds flow we recommend /v1/sessions handshake returning a short-lived JWT. Example snippet: ```POST /v1/sessions {"client_id":"MARKETLANE_APP","expires_in":300} -> {"token":"<jwt>","expires_in":300}``` Rotate tokens at 4m intervals for continuous flows.
olivia_sales: They asked for latency guidance when caching + batching are enabled. Any ballparks?
alyssa_prod: Ballparks on Dedicated mid-tier: p50 ~80-140ms, p95 ~260-420ms for ~300-token flows with batching enabled. If you lower batch window to <3ms you'll reduce p95 but increase GPU cost. Enabling KV cache cuts effective token generation time when prefixes reoccur, often reducing cost 30-70% depending on repetition.
diego_sre: For bursts, we recommend a small burst pool and autoscale thresholds tuned to promo patterns. Also include a pre-warm step before scheduled promos.
olivia_sales: Pricing ask: they want reserved commit but with burst capacity. Recommend a starting commit?
alyssa_prod: For their profile suggest a 3-month pilot: reserve capacity for steady + 30% buffer (covers most peaks) and add a 1-2 GPU burst pool. Offer pilot discount (10-15%) and re-evaluate after promo simulation. I'll draft numbers.
legal-bot: security-questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/presales/marketlane/sq.pdf (SOC2 mapping, KMS options, field-encryption patterns).
priya_se: I'll produce a one-page customer checklist in ~30m: items: handshake test, ephemeral token rotation test, proxy IP binding check, streaming functioncall echo test, structured JSON schema validation (include example schema), burst load simulation script.
olivia_sales: Amazing. Can SRE produce a cURL snippet we can hand to their infra team to validate streaming toolcalls through proxy?
diego_sre: Will post snippet and a minimal load script. snippet will include X-Forwarded-For header example and a streaming toolcall curl with chunked transfer.
olivia_sales: Great, looping solutions-arch for an architecture review and legal for the questionnaire. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
